title: The Inca Empire
description: The Inca Empire – 17-Day Accessible Journey Through Peru. Experience the best of Peru in 17 unforgettable days—safely, comfortably, and without limits. The Inca Empire takes you from the coast of Lima, Paracas, and Ica, to the white city of Arequipa, the majestic Colca Canyon, the sacred waters of Lake Titicaca, and deep into the heart of the Andes in Cusco and Machu Picchu.
highlights: Personalized support and care throughout your journey
slogan: Accessible Travel Peru 🇵🇪 - Making Peru Accessible for Everyone ♿

itinerary.title: Arrival in Lima – Welcome to Peru
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival at Lima International Airport, our team will be waiting to greet you with a warm welcome and provide comfortable, accessible transportation to your hotel in the city. Once settled in, you'll have some time to rest after your journey. Later, we'll meet for a briefing session at the hotel, where we'll go over the details of your adventure, answer any questions, and share helpful tips for the days ahead. You'll also receive any mobility equipment or support devices arranged for your trip, ensuring everything is ready for a safe and enriching experience. From the moment you land, we are here to support you with personalized, accessible service every step of the way. Welcome to Peru—your unforgettable journey begins now!

itinerary.title: Lima City Tour – Contrasts of the City of Kings
itinerary.description: Start your Peruvian adventure with a fascinating tour of Lima, the vibrant capital known as the City of Kings. Begin in the elegant coastal district of Miraflores, where you'll enjoy scenic ocean views and a panoramic stop at Huaca Pucllana, an ancient adobe pyramid that speaks to the city's pre-Columbian past. Then, journey into the heart of the Historic Center of Lima, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Admire the colonial balconies, grand architecture, and charming plazas. Visit the beautiful Convent of Santo Domingo, home to centuries of spiritual and cultural history. A delicious lunch at a local restaurant is included, featuring a taste of Peru's world-famous cuisine. The tour is fully accessible, with adapted transportation and dedicated assistance to ensure comfort and inclusion at every stop. OPTIONAL: After Lunch Tour to the Larco Herrera Museum ($40 per person) or Gastronomic tour and demo class ($70 per person). A day filled with history, flavor, and unforgettable first impressions of Peru.

itinerary.title: Journey to Ica – Vineyards & Huacachina Oasis
itinerary.description: Early in the morning, depart from Lima and travel south along the scenic Panamerican Highway toward the Ica region, known for its warm desert landscapes and rich viticultural heritage. Your first stop will be at a traditional vineyard and pisco bodega, where you'll learn about the production of Peru's national spirit, taste local wines and piscos, and explore the history behind these family-run establishments. Enjoy a delicious lunch at the vineyard or nearby local restaurant. In the afternoon, visit the iconic Huacachina Oasis—a breathtaking natural lagoon surrounded by soaring sand dunes. You'll have time to relax, take in the views, or simply enjoy the peaceful desert atmosphere. After a day filled with flavors and scenery, transfer to your accessible hotel in Ica for check-in and overnight stay. A perfect start to your coastal adventure—where tradition and desert magic come together.

itinerary.title: Nature, Nazca Lines & Return to Lima
itinerary.description: After an early breakfast, head to the Paracas dock for an exciting boat tour to the Ballestas Islands, home to sea lions, Humboldt penguins, and countless seabirds. Along the way, enjoy a panoramic view of the mysterious Candelabra geoglyph, etched into the coastal cliffs centuries ago. For those seeking an unforgettable perspective, enjoy a scenic overflight of the Nazca Lines—a 1-hour aerial tour over the world-famous geoglyphs carved into the desert floor. Lunch at a local seaside restaurant. In the afternoon, begin your journey back to Lima via accessible private transport. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel for check-in and rest. A day of ocean wonders, ancient mysteries, and stunning desert views—closing your coastal adventure with awe. Optional Experience: Explore the dramatic landscapes of the Paracas National Reserve—where desert and ocean meet in one of Peru's most unique ecosystems. Visit stunning viewpoints, learn about the area's wildlife, and take in the silence and beauty of the coastal desert. ($50 per person)

itinerary.title: Flight to Arequipa & City Tour – The White City Awaits
itinerary.description: In the morning, we will transfer you to Jorge Chávez International Airport for your flight to Arequipa, known as La Ciudad Blanca for its stunning white volcanic stone architecture. Upon arrival, our team will greet you and provide accessible transportation to your hotel for check-in and a short rest. In the afternoon, enjoy a guided City Tour of Arequipa, where you'll explore its charming historic center, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Visit iconic landmarks such as the Plaza de Armas, the beautiful Cathedral, and the impressive Santa Catalina Monastery, a city within a city filled with history and color. The tour includes accessible routes and personalized assistance to ensure comfort throughout the day. A perfect welcome to the Andes and a city full of elegance, history, and soul.

itinerary.title: Journey to the Colca Valley – Andean Landscapes & Local Flavors
itinerary.description: After breakfast, we'll depart from Arequipa towards the spectacular Colca Valley, one of the deepest canyons in the world and home to breathtaking scenery and traditional highland culture. Enjoy a scenic drive across the Salinas and Aguada Blanca Reserve, where you'll spot wild vicuñas, llamas, and alpacas grazing in the vast puna landscapes. Along the way, we'll stop at panoramic viewpoints like Patapampa, located over 4,900 meters above sea level, where the surrounding volcanoes rise majestically on the horizon. A delicious lunch featuring local ingredients is included in a traditional restaurant along the route. In the afternoon, arrive at your hotel in the Colca area, where you'll have time to rest, enjoy the peaceful mountain air, or take in the surroundings at your own pace. Overnight stay in the heart of the Andes, where nature, silence, and stars await.

itinerary.title: Colca Canyon & Journey to Puno – Condors and Highland Roads
itinerary.description: Early in the morning, we'll head to the iconic Cruz del Cóndor viewpoint to witness the majestic flight of the Andean condors as they soar gracefully above one of the deepest canyons on Earth. Along the way, you'll enjoy stunning views of the valley's pre-Inca terraces, snowcapped peaks, and traditional villages. After this unforgettable experience, we'll begin our journey across the Andean Altiplano toward Puno, located on the shores of Lake Titicaca, the highest navigable lake in the world. A stop will be made for lunch en route, with time to rest and stretch along the scenic drive. Upon arrival in Puno, transfer to your accessible hotel for check-in and overnight stay. A day filled with nature, wildlife, and the changing colors of the Andes, ending by the sacred lake of the Incas.

itinerary.title: Free Day in Puno – Rest, Breathe & Enjoy the Altiplano
itinerary.description: After several days of adventure through the Andes, today is a well-deserved free day to relax and recharge in Puno, on the shores of the legendary Lake Titicaca. Take this opportunity to enjoy the peaceful atmosphere of the highlands, rest at your accessible hotel, or explore the city at your own pace. You can stroll through the local plazas, sip a warm herbal tea with a lake view, or simply unwind and acclimate before continuing your journey. Our team will be available for any assistance or to suggest optional activities, depending on your interests and energy. Sometimes, the most powerful moments of a journey are the quiet ones.

itinerary.title: Lake Titicaca – Uros & Taquile Islands
itinerary.description: Explore the magic of Lake Titicaca on a full-day boat tour to the floating Uros Islands and the traditional island of Taquile. Start your day navigating the highest navigable lake in the world as you visit the unique Uros community, where locals live on handmade reed islands. Then continue to Taquile, known for its rich textile traditions and stunning lake views. Enjoy a freshly prepared lunch on Taquile Island, featuring local ingredients and Andean hospitality. The tour includes adapted assistance and personalized support to ensure a safe and inclusive experience on the water and the islands. Return to Puno in the late afternoon with unforgettable memories of Peru's living lake cultures.

itinerary.title: Overland, Cusco to Puno – Scenic Route with Cultural Stops
itinerary.description: Today, travel from Cusco to Puno along one of the most scenic and culturally rich routes in the Andes. This full-day road journey includes several fascinating stops along the way, offering a deeper look into Peru's history and highland landscapes. You'll visit traditional villages, ancient ruins, and beautiful viewpoints as we make our way south toward Lake Titicaca. A hearty buffet lunch is included in a picturesque Andean town, featuring local ingredients and traditional flavors. Accessible transportation and assistance are provided to ensure comfort throughout the day. Arrive in Puno by evening and settle into your hotel to rest and prepare for your Lake Titicaca adventure. Optional: Route Cusco to Puno by Train. Lunch and Folkloric Show Included. ($260 per person)

itinerary.title: Afternoon City Tour – Inca Capital Awaits
itinerary.description: This afternoon, we'll visit Cusco, the historic capital of the Inca Empire nestled in the heart of the Andes. City Tour of Cusco, a journey through time and tradition. Visit the sacred Qoricancha, the Inca Temple of the Sun, and walk through the iconic Plaza de Armas, surrounded by colonial charm and lively culture. Then, explore the awe-inspiring fortress of Sacsayhuaman, followed by visits to Tambomachay and panoramic stops at Qenko and Puka Pukara, where the spirit of the Andes still lingers in every stone. Accessible transportation and personal support are provided to ensure your comfort throughout the day. A magical first glimpse into Cusco's living history and timeless majesty.

itinerary.title: Sacred Valley Full Day – Pisac, Urubamba & Ollantaytambo
itinerary.description: Today you'll explore the breathtaking Sacred Valley of the Incas, a place where history, culture, and nature come together in perfect harmony. Start your day in Pisac, wandering through its colorful artisan market and admiring the terraced hillsides of its ancient ruins. Continue to Urubamba, where you'll enjoy a delicious buffet lunch featuring local Andean flavors. In the afternoon, visit the impressive fortress of Ollantaytambo, a living Inca town filled with stories carved in stone. This day offers not only incredible views but also a deep connection with the spirit of the Andes. Accessible transportation and personal assistance are included to ensure a smooth and enriching experience for all. A day full of culture, flavors, and awe-inspiring beauty—straight from the heart of the Andes.

itinerary.title: Rainbow Mountain Full Day Tour | Accessible Experience
itinerary.description: Join us for an unforgettable accessible adventure to the stunning Rainbow Mountain! This full-day tour includes scenic views of the Andes, local encounters, and a delicious countryside lunch. Box lunch included for the journey featuring native corn, Andean potatoes, fresh cheese, and alpaca meat. Adapted support and assistance throughout the experience. Breathe in the beauty of the Peruvian highlands and witness one of nature's most colorful wonders—safely and comfortably.

itinerary.title: Living Culture in Cuper Bajo, Chinchero
itinerary.description: This morning, immerse yourself in the daily life of the Cuper Bajo community, located on the peaceful shores of Lake Piuray, high in the Andes of Chinchero. Be welcomed by local families and experience authentic Andean living culture through an enriching and hands-on exchange. Discover the ancient art of textile weaving—from shearing and spinning wool to learning how they create vibrant colors using natural dyes from native plants, minerals, and insects. You'll also explore their agricultural traditions, learning about the native crops they grow—such as potatoes, corn, and quinoa—and the deep connection they maintain with Pachamama (Mother Earth). The experience includes a delicious traditional Pachamanca lunch, where meats and vegetables are slow-cooked underground with hot stones—a true celebration of Andean flavors and community. This activity is designed to be accessible and inclusive, with adapted support to ensure comfort and full participation for every traveler. A morning of culture, nature, and connection—shared with the warm hearts of the Andes. Optionals: Accessible ATV off road excursion around Piuray Lagoon ($35 per person), Day with shaman, energetic cleansing and payment to the earth for prosperity ($65 per person)

itinerary.title: Machu Picchu Full Day Tour | From Cusco & Back
itinerary.description: Today, you'll embark on a full-day adventure to the majestic citadel of Machu Picchu. Early in the morning, we'll transfer you from your hotel to the train station for a scenic journey through the Sacred Valley. Upon arrival in Aguas Calientes, you'll take a short bus ride up the mountain to reach the entrance of Machu Picchu. Enjoy a guided tour of this iconic Inca sanctuary, adapted to your pace and needs, with plenty of time to take in the breathtaking views and history. After exploring the site, return to Aguas Calientes for a delicious lunch at a local restaurant before heading back to Cusco by train and private transfer. Accessible assistance provided throughout the day for a smooth and enriching experience. Optional: Panoramic train service ($100 per person, round trip, includes support staff to assist you on the train), Luxury Hiram Bingham Train service, includes brunch, Lunch and happy hour ($1275 per person, round trip. Includes support staff to assist you on the train)

itinerary.title: Return to Lima – Magic Water Show & Farewell Dinner
itinerary.description: In the morning or early afternoon, transfer to the Cusco airport for your flight back to Lima. Upon arrival, our team will welcome you and provide accessible transportation to your hotel. In the evening, enjoy a special outing to the famous Magic Water Circuit at Parque de la Reserva—a dazzling display of lights, fountains, and music in one of the largest water parks in the world. Afterward, gather for a heartfelt farewell dinner at a local restaurant, where we'll celebrate the unforgettable journey you've experienced through the land of the Incas. A night of lights, flavor, and gratitude to honor your adventure across Peru.

itinerary.title: Time to say Good Bye...
itinerary.description: After 13 incredible days discovering the soul of Peru—its colors, flavors, landscapes, and people—it's time to say goodbye, but not farewell forever. This morning, we'll accompany you to Cusco Airport, where you'll board your flight back to Lima to connect with your international journey home. As your adventure ends, we hope your heart is full of unforgettable moments, meaningful connections, and a deep bond with this magical land. Thank you for letting us be part of your journey. It has been a true honor to travel with you. We'll be waiting with open arms whenever you return. And like the Inca's says... TUPAYANCHIS K'AMA! - Until life meet us again… ¡Hasta pronto!
